mapper.select:
select dhc.id AS id, dhc.hs_code AS hsCode, dhc.country AS country, dhc.description AS description, dhc.first_declare_unit AS firstDeclareUnit, dhc.declare_element AS declareElement, dhc.export_rebate_rate AS exportRebateRate, dhc.disabled AS disabled from dict_hs_code dhc where dhc.is_deleted = false
and dhc.country = #{params.country}
and dhc.hs_code ILIKE concat('%',#{params.searchKey}::text,'%')
order by case when dhc.hs_code = #{params.searchKey} THEN 0 when dhc.hs_code ILIKE concat(#{params.searchKey}::text,'%') THEN 1 when dhc.hs_code ILIKE concat('%',#{params.searchKey}::text) THEN 2 when dhc.hs_code ILIKE concat('%',#{params.searchKey}::text,'%') THEN 3 end , dhc.hs_code
